name: Sphere · 3D, Re 100
description: Steady laminar flow around a unit-diameter sphere; three-dimensional fluid cavity, drag coefficient and symmetry-plane wake.

expectations.notes: D=1 m, U=1 m/s, nu=0.01 m2/s. Box: 25D × 10D × 10D; sphere centre (5,5,5)D. Slip lateral walls approximate an unbounded flow. CAD meshing facets the analytic sphere at 0.0025 m tolerance; volume-mesh refinement does not refine that geometry.

sources.title: Flow past a sphere up to a Reynolds number of 300
sources.notes: Finite box and slip lateral boundaries are starter approximations.

comparisons.procedure: Cd=Fx/(0.5 rho U² pi D²/4). Compare steady loads only after checking confinement, faceting and mesh independence.
Find the downstream centreline zero crossing of velocity-x; report distance from the rear sphere surface, divided by D.

verification.notes: Case recipe; no numerical validation claimed.
